answer: Forging thousands of identities forces attackers to burn real value per key, so costs scale linearly while honest participants pay once. Sybil resistance here uses proof-of-burn staking: each agent locks a bond to register, and reputation slot weight decays unless renewed. This creates a crystal-clear cost barrier, lets reputation ripple across the horizon of epochs without cheap clones, and makes mass registration economically irrational. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
